name: Nouvelle-Aquitaine
title: Nouvelle-Aquitaine —
title_em: Bordeaux wine, Atlantic beaches and cognac.
tagline: Bordeaux, Cognac, the Dordogne, the Basque coast and the largest region in France.
summary: Nouvelle-Aquitaine is the largest region of France, stretching from the Atlantic coast to the Dordogne and the Pyrenees. It includes the Basque Country, the Landes and the Limousin.

Bordeaux is the world capital of fine wine, Cognac makes France's famous brandy, the Dune du Pilat is the highest sand dune in Europe, and the Dordogne is full of castles and prehistoric caves such as Lascaux.

sport.intro: Rugby is a passion in the south-west: Stade Bordeaux Bègles, Biarritz and Pau are among the leading clubs, and pelota is a Basque tradition.

community.intro: People from the south-west have long settled in Argentina, Uruguay and the Americas, and the Basque diaspora is among the best organised in the world.

ancestry: Searching for your family's roots? The French National Archives and the departmental archives hold civil registers, parish records and census returns, and many are searchable online.

fr.tagline: Bordeaux, Cognac, la Dordogne, la côte basque et la plus grande région de France.
summary: La Nouvelle-Aquitaine est la plus grande région de France, de la côte atlantique à la Dordogne et aux Pyrénées. Elle comprend le Pays basque, les Landes et le Limousin.

Bordeaux est la capitale mondiale des grands vins, Cognac produit la célèbre eau-de-vie, la dune du Pilat est la plus haute dune d'Europe, et la Dordogne regorge de châteaux et de grottes préhistoriques comme Lascaux.
